public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic's annualized revenue method (four weeks of API revenue x13) is easily manipulated by product launches.

statement.excerpt: So, Anthropic is annualizing based on the last four weeks of API revenue times 13, a number that’s extremely easy to manipulate using, say, launches of new products.

from_speaker: the last four weeks of API revenue times 13
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that temporary launch-driven spending can readily raise the reported run rate beyond a sustainable revenue pace.
This is a claim about practical susceptibility to manipulation, not necessarily an allegation that a particular disclosure was fraudulent.
Verifying the multiplier establishes only the formula. Establishing easy manipulation also requires evidence about the size, duration, and controllability of launch-driven spending.
The supplied context identifies the February-to-early-April 2026 reporting sequence as the relevant episode.
criteria.support_condition: The stated formula operated during the target episode, and measured launch-driven spending shows a material, temporary uplift that could readily be captured in the reported run rate.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant formula differs materially, or suitable evidence shows that the asserted launch-driven manipulation mechanism does not operate.
